title: Naturality of the explicit restricted cone comparison
statement: For any preordered I, diagram D : Iᵒᵖ → Over S, cone c, coefficients F and transitions phi, coefficient diagram H on the cone point, isomorphisms eH identifying its objects with the inverse images of F_i, and the transition equation hH in lean.statement, the explicit eG of [def-sbc-restricted-affine-single-maps] intertwines the arrows of the concrete restricted diagram G [def-sbc-restricted-affine-coefficient-construction] with the explicit restricted transitions and the complex inverse-image cone composition comparison. No transition identity/composition laws, directedness, nonemptiness, or colimit are assumed.

source.place: Tag 09Z1 proof, restriction to an affine etale object; Tag 0EZM coefficient complexes; Tag 03CB canonical inverse-image composition comparisons

proof.text:
Expand the explicit cone isomorphisms and restricted transitions, and substitute
hH for the coefficient diagram arrow. Write q_i for a restricted cone leg, r_i for
the stage second projection, and r for the cone point second projection. The pullback
projection identity is q_i followed by r_i equals r followed by c_i. The cone triangle
identifies q_j followed by the restricted transition with q_i. Apply upperStarComp_assoc
first to the triangle of the two original cone legs and the original transition, then
to the corresponding restricted triangle, and then to the second-projection squares.
Naturality moves the images of eH and of the coefficient transition through these
comparisons. Cancel inverse comparisons and the adjacent eH isomorphisms. Applying
singleFunctor and its natural inverse-image comparison gives the displayed equation.
This argument needs only hH, not the coefficient transition laws or any colimit.
